name: Hunchback chung cake
summary: A Red Dao cake. Vietnam Tourism uses upland sticky rice, small green beans, black pork, and galangal leaves, boiled 8–10 hours on a wood stove. Dân Việt describes a palm-sized cake shaped like a woman with a basket, of sticky rice, mung beans, and fatty meat, in one layer of dong leaves, chewy from upland sticky rice. Both lists stay.
origin: The Hà Giang region on Vietnam Tourism’s food page, and Đồng Văn on Dân Việt.
texture: Dân Việt says the cake is soft and chewy.
howToEat: Eat it as a cake. Vietnam Tourism does not add a dipping sauce. No clock is given.
where: On the plateau, and in Đồng Văn.
seoTitle: Hunchback chung cake in Ha Giang — banh chung gu
seoDescription: Bánh chưng gù keeps both recipes: an 8–10 hour boil with black pork, and Dân Việt’s palm-sized cake of sticky rice, mung beans, and fatty meat.
